trickyParts: happy-dom raises `error` synchronously from the `src` attribute setter when the URL cannot resolve (page at about:blank); the img is appended to the wrapper before `src` is set so a synchronous error replaces it rather than preceding it. Real browsers queue the error as a task; the ordering is right either way, and a unit case holds it.

The Playwright harness and `bun run dispatch:local` need a loopback Postgres with pgvector; this sandbox has no Docker, so one was built under /tmp from Debian packages (nothing in the repository) and left running for the tester's own run: `export LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/tmp/pg/usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu PATH=/tmp/pg/usr/lib/postgresql/17/bin:$PATH DATABASE_URL='postgres://postgres@127.0.0.1:55432/dispatch_e2e?sslmode=disable'` (restart with `postgres -D /tmp/pgdata -p 55432 -h 127.0.0.1 -k /tmp/pgsock` if it is gone).

The simplify pass (ce-simplify-code, three reviewer subagents) applied one change, to the unit test only (literal paths and words in the link test); runtime code is unchanged since the proof's head, so the browser proof was not re-run. discoveredComplexity: Pre-existing, not changed here: a paragraph that ends in a picture is ~115 px tall in the editor whatever the picture's size, because ProseMirror's cursor hack after a contenteditable=false leaf (``) gets Tailwind preflight's `display: block` and Typography's `.prose img` 2em margins. Measured on the plain `` path too (`![logo](https://example.invalid/logo.png)` → 115.19 px), so it predates this change; the fix would be a `.milkdown img.ProseMirror-separator` rule in styles.css, a separate issue for the architect.
